name: message-testimonials
title: Message testimonials
description: Real customer messages shown as a calm chat: grouped bubbles with sender and time, for the praise that arrives by DM or email.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, threads ({ id, channel, date, messages: [{ from, text, time, avatar?, own? }], dateTime?, icon? }) and an optional note ('Shared with permission, lightly trimmed for length'). Two or three threads read well. Consecutive messages from one sender are grouped under one avatar, name and time; a message with own: true is from your team and sits on the right in an outlined bubble. Bubbles are plain text with no copied interface and nothing animates. Each thread is a list named 'Messages from Anna, 12 March', and every message is read with its sender and time. labels carries the fixed words.
